source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Retains troop/daughter wordplay and judge/rod humiliation; cutting oneself alternative noted.
Preserves smallness, divine for me, and temporal range without settling preexistence versus ancestral origins in text.
Keeps unnamed he and mother, and male kinship brothers without inserting later identities.
Keeps peace as predicate and seven/eight escalation rather than exact roster speculation.
Preserves pointed entrances, sword shepherding, and plural-to-singular agency.
Follows pinned cities rather than emending to idols and retains named cult objects.
